title: Bevel download dock
description: A floating get-the-app prompt. On desktop a small dark card with a QR code and two lines sits in the bottom-right corner and fades out over the first screen of scrolling. On phones a white rounded banner (app icon, name, tagline, stars and a dark pill) slides up from the bottom while the visitor scrolls back up.
notes: fixed: place it once on a page, anywhere
the desktop fade is a CSS scroll timeline (no JavaScript); the phone banner's show-on-scroll-up needs JavaScript
name: bevel-download-dock

props.name: qr
props.description: desktop card: the QR code image (a placeholder square when empty)

props.name: qrText
props.description: desktop card: the small line under the title

props.name: appIcon
props.description: phone banner: the app icon (a placeholder tile when empty)

props.name: appTagline
props.description: phone banner: the line under the name

props.name: rating
props.description: phone banner: star rating out of five (halves allowed)

props.name: ratingLabel
props.description: phone banner: the text after the stars (e.g. a count of ratings)
